svg.title: MCP versus WebMCP
svg.desc: Two panels. MCP is a persistent server of tools available anywhere. WebMCP is a live webpage that registers tools for a browser agent while the tab is open.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Named tools with schemas. MCP lives on a server. WebMCP lives in the tab.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
